name: Negative test: denied camera permission should not hang
goal: Verify the app recovers gracefully when a detection attempt cannot capture a photo.
steps: Tap the camera surface to trigger detection.
Wait for the app to recover or show an actionable message.
expected_result: When capture is unavailable, the app should stop loading and present a recoverable state or clear permission guidance.
success_criteria: The app does not remain indefinitely loading.
The user can retry, grant permission, or return to the idle home state.

ground_truth.rationale: The current detection handler sets loading true before capture and does not reset loading when no photo is returned.
ground_truth.known_failure_mode: Camera-denied capture path can leave the full-screen loading indicator visible indefinitely.
